dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.line: We need to get in and out, no more than 5 minutes. The security system resets every 6 minutes.
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Alex's face, intense lighting highlighting his determination

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.line: I've got the ventilation route mapped out. We can drop in from the east side, avoid the main cameras.
dialogue.visual_cue: Over-the-shoulder shot of May, her eyes fixed on the blueprints

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.line: What's the plan if we get caught? We can't take on the whole security team.
dialogue.visual_cue: Low-angle shot of May, her voice low and urgent

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.line: We won't get caught. We have the element of surprise, and I've got a contingency plan in place.
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Alex's hands, gripping a small pouch of lockpicks

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.line: Now's our chance. The guard is making his rounds, we have 3 minutes to get to the server room.
dialogue.visual_cue: Wide shot of the office building, the camera panning up to the roof

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.line: Let's move, I've got the hacking tool ready. We need to disable the alarms before we can access the data.
